about_short_description.short_description: Step is a financial services company that builds mobile-based banking for teenagers.

product.name: Step Money App
product.description: A mobile financial services platform that combines spending, money management, savings, credit building, rewards, and investing features for teenagers and young adults.

product.name: Step Visa Card
product.description: A secured Visa card linked to a Step Spending Account that lets users make purchases with deposited funds while building credit through reported payment history.

product.name: Step Black
product.description: A paid or qualifying-direct-deposit membership that provides enhanced savings rewards, cashback, and other benefits within the Step platform.

product.name: Step EarlyPay
product.description: An earned-access cash service that may let eligible users borrow up to $250 and transfer funds to their Step Account before their scheduled payday.

product.name: Step Savings
product.description: A savings feature within the Step account that lets users set aside funds and, for eligible Step Black members, receive a variable cash reward calculated at an advertised 3.00% rate.

product.name: Step Rewards
product.description: A purchase-rewards program that provides cashback on eligible transactions, including unlimited 1% cashback and higher rates with selected Step Black partners.
